This data set is a result of the first quantitative survey of Canadian nurses to explore their access to and use of digital health in nursing practice. It was a joint collaboration between the Canadian Nurses Association and Canada Health Infoway. Harris Decima, a third-party, vendor administered the online survey in collaboration with the Infoway and the CNA.
